candidate_sentences.text: Kvika Banki hf. reported a Q2 2026 pre-tax profit of ISK 1,545 million, a decrease of 23.7 percent year-over-year and 14.6 percent from Q1 2026.

The decline stemmed directly from a compressed net interest margin, which dropped to 4.0 percent from 4.5 percent in the prior quarter, and a 26.8 percent year-over-year drop in fee income to ISK 1,416 million due to sluggish capital markets.

Additionally, net impairment provisions doubled to ISK 269 million, a cost efficiency charge added ISK 112 million to expenses, and the effective tax rate climbed to 34.8 percent from 24.4 percent following funding derivative closures.
Underlying cost management held firm, with administrative expenses decreasing 1.1 percent to ISK 2,947 million despite the charge, paving the way for ISK 300 to 400 million in annualized savings.

verified_key_information_units.information: Deposits surpassed ISK 200 billion for the first time, reaching ISK 201.2 billion at quarter-end, up 16.5% from year-end 2025, driven by retail deposits and public entities, while loans to customers grew to ISK 223.3 billion, up 7.6% from year-end 2025.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Deposits amounted to ISK 201.2 bn. at the end of Q2 2026, increasing by 16.5% from year-end 2025. Loans to customers amounted to ISK 223.3 bn. at the end of Q2 2026, increasing by ISK 15.8 bn., or 7.6%, from year-end 2025.

Deposits advanced 16.5 percent year-over-year to ISK 201.2 billion, driving the loan-to-deposit ratio down to 111 percent.

verified_key_information_units.information: Capital adequacy ratio (CAR) stood at 23.0% at 30 June 2026, down from 26.8% at year-end 2025 primarily due to the ISK 10.2 billion special dividend payment in June, while maintaining a strong management buffer above regulatory requirements.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: CAR of 23.0% at 30 June 2026, decreasing as special dividend was distributed in June. The bank continues to target a management buffer of 2% to 4% over current and anticipated CAR requirements.
